boc_buy_per_100.label: BOC spot buying rate, CNY per USD 100

boc_sell_per_100.label: BOC spot selling rate, CNY per USD 100 (the rate a customer pays to buy USD)

boc_cash_sell_per_100.label: BOC cash selling rate, CNY per USD 100

boc_fee_rate.label: BOC cross-border wire commission, share of the amount

boc_fee_min_cny.label: BOC commission minimum per wire, CNY

boc_fee_max_cny.label: BOC commission maximum per wire, CNY

boc_cable_cny.label: BOC cable fee per wire outside Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, CNY

quota_usd_year.label: Annual facilitation quota, USD per person per calendar year

wise_cap_cny.label: Wise maximum per transfer from a China bank app, CNY

atm_cap_cny_year.label: Overseas cash withdrawal cap per person per calendar year, CNY (excerpt level)

carry_free_usd.label: Foreign cash that may leave China without a permit, USD

carry_permit_usd.label: Foreign cash that may leave China with a bank-issued permit, USD

fine_ordinary.label: Upper limit of the fine in an ordinary case, share of the amount (Arts. 39, 40, 45)

fine_serious.label: Upper limit of the fine in a serious case, share of the amount (Arts. 39, 40, 45)

fine_carry.label: Upper limit of the fine for carrying FX across the border in breach (Art. 42)

us_recv_fee_usd.label: Example US receiving-bank fee per incoming wire, USD (Chase; excerpt level; not in the headline cost)
